name: protein A (RdRp)
note: The ONLY CDS on RNA1 in this group. Orsay 937, Le Blanc 942, Santeuil 982 aa.

name: capsid protein
note: 388-391 aa, initiated at a NON-AUG codon: the Edman-sequenced mature N-terminus NKNNT corresponds to the AAC codon at RNA2 nt 89-91, with no AUG 5' of it in the segment.

name: CP-delta fusion
note: Made by a -1 programmed ribosomal frameshift at the slippery heptamer G_UCA_AAC, RNA2 nt 1255-1261, with a stem-loop about 8 nt downstream and no pseudoknot. The transframe peptide was sequenced by MS/MS and the protein is a virion head fiber.

name: free delta
note: Initiated at its own AUG (Orsay RNA2 nt 1345) and equal to the C-terminal part of the fusion. Existence as a free protein settled by an ATG-to-CTG mutant that still makes CP-delta but has a non-lytic egress defect. Absent from RefSeq NC_028098.1 and present only in HM030971.2.

name: B2
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. PMID 21283608 searched RNA1's 3' end for a +1 ORF with B2's properties and found none; PMID 23468484 detected no silencing-suppressor activity for either Orsay protein proposed as one. ABSENT here is the expected and required result and is what separates this module from every other nodavirus module.

name: B1
note: DELIBERATELY ABSENT, for the same reason as B2: RNA1 carries a single CDS and no subgenomic RNA3 has been described in this group.
